tex_content.html:
Lemma
Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0083 1. Lemma 3.9\group variation-formulas

The volume form satisfies \[ \partial _t d\mu =\frac12(g^{ij}\partial _t g_{ij})\, d\mu =\frac{H}{2}\, d\mu . \]

Proof

Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0083 \sketch Differentiate $d\mu =\sqrt{\det g}\, dx^1\wedge \cdots \wedge dx^n$ and use $\partial _t\log \det g=g^{ij}\partial _t g_{ij}$.

□
